name: Oye Wapas Rakh Use
visual_description: Two-panel image of Kabir Singh (Shahid Kapoor) turning back and furiously pointing forward with text subtitles 'Oye!!' and 'Wapas Rakh Use'.
usage_context: Used to express aggressive possessiveness, warning someone not to touch or take something belonging to you.

example.caption: When someone picks up the last slice of pizza you claimed

text_areas.description: Top context or situation triggering the warning
